## What and why / 改了什么、为什么

## How it was tested / 如何验证

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests`

## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] Tests added or updated for behaviour changes / 行为变化有对应的测试
- [ ] User-facing docs updated, in both `README.md` and `README.en.md` where relevant / 面向用户的文档已更新（涉及时中英文 README 都要改）
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under "Unreleased" / 已在 `CHANGELOG.md` 的 "Unreleased" 下记录
- [ ] Simulation results are labelled as simulation / 仿真结果已标明来自仿真
- [ ] Safety behaviour is not weakened, or the change is explained and tested / 未削弱安全行为，或已说明并测试
- [ ] No third-party code, weights or media without a compatible licence / 未引入许可证不兼容的第三方代码、权重或素材
